A new need may name an earlier need as parent and may cite only verified read IDs in discovered_from. Every action after planning must include a non-null task-relevant tool linked by need_id to a registered need. Formulate task-relevant search queries and read only candidates returned in this episode for that need, and use reason/role_spans when enabled. Zero search matches are not proof of absence. A final object is exactly {"finish":{"findings":list,"open_questions":list}}. Findings have exactly need_id, claim, stance (supports, defeats, unknown, conflicted, or hypothetical), citations, and reason, with optional role_support for an actual joint result. Every registered need needs a finding. citations is an array of verified read IDs, empty only for hypothetical or unknown findings. Every unknown needs a same-need open question naming the unresolved premise. Open questions have exactly need_id and question. Cite the joint seed, premises, terminal and authority reads when using role_support. Do not turn missing, ambiguous, stale or exhausted evidence into a settled answer. Pass a list of candidate numbers to read to open those candidates together. Every candidate in a read list counts against the read allowance.
